subject: Greenfield Labs — price-match request & migration readiness
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@greenfieldlabs.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: price match vs AstraScale + migration assistance

Jordan —

Thanks for taking the call today. Quick follow-up: Greenfield Labs has received a 24-month committed quote from AstraScale that includes a $0.009/token list price for generation, a 20% trial credit, and $120k in migration/onboarding credits. Our procurement team (cc'd Priya) has asked whether Redwood can match the headline economics and also provide a runbook/assurance for a two-week pilot migration window.

Key asks:
- Can you match the $0.009/token rate for committed volume of ~150M tokens/month for 24 months?
- Any short-term starter credits or pilot credits to offset migration cost?
- Details on private VPC onboarding timeline and who owns the egress costs?

I've attached the AstraScale quote for reference (greenfield-astrascale-quote.pdf).

We'd like a written counterproposal by next Wednesday EOD if possible — procurement needs it for the vendor evaluation pack.

Best,
Tom
Director of AI Platforms
Greenfield Labs

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@greenfieldlabs.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: price match vs AstraScale + migration assistance

Tom —

Appreciate the context and the quote. We're happy to evaluate a price-match and put a practical migration offer together. I'll loop in our AE (Priyom) and Solutions (Karthik) to scope any technical deltas that might affect the commitment.

High level: most price-match asks are doable if we align on committed run-rate and a short mutual action plan (pilot acceptance criteria, timeline, and a small onboarding credit). I'll get you a formal counter by Wednesday EOD as requested.

Two quick questions to help us size the offer:
- Is the 150M tokens/month steady-state or ramping across the 24 months?
- Do you require private deployment (VPC/on-prem) day one or are you open to a hosted + private cutover?

Thanks — sending internal note now.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-01T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Greenfield price-match request — commercial levers

Jordan / team —

Quick internal take before we draft the formal:
- Volume: if 150M tokens/mo is steady, this is sizable — the list-price match to $0.009 is close to our reserved/deep-discount band if they commit to 24 months and provide a minimum quarterly true-up.
- Concessions we can consider without exec sign: 2 months pilot credit (applied as invoice credit), 3 months of free private onboarding support (SWE + infra), and a one-time migration credit up to $75k. Anything larger will need Marissa's OK.
- We should avoid permanent list-price discount across all SKUs; instead structure as term-limited price-match plus onboarding credit and SLA credit on go-live to protect unit economics.

Action: I'll draft the counter and the mutual action plan. Jordan — confirm whether we should include an escape/fallthrough to a slightly higher gen price after month 12 if usage is below a threshold.

Priyom
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-02T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Greenfield price-match request — commercial levers

Team —

Thanks Priyom. Approved guidelines below:
- We can offer a temporary price-match to $0.009/token for the first 12 months tied to a 24-month contract and quarterly minimums (min quarterly tokens = 0.75 * expected run-rate) — after 12 months, price will step to $0.0105/token unless usage thresholds are met.
- Approve up to $100k in one-time migration/onboarding credit (conditional on documented MOP and acceptance criteria).
- Approve 60 days of pilot credits (applied as invoice credit) to accelerate technical validation.
- Approve a technical jumpstart: dedicated SE time (up to 2 weeks) + priority onboarding queue for private deployment.

Please keep the concessions time-limited and tied to the signed MAP. Jordan — you have authority to finalize the counteroffer within these bounds. Priyom, include the step-up language and min quarterly true-up in the commercial terms.

Marissa
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@greenfieldlabs.com>, Priya Nayar <buyer@greenfieldlabs.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-07T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Formal counter — price match + migration package (GF-2027-091)

Tom / Priya —

Thanks for your patience — attached is our formal counter for Greenfield (pricing_sheet_v1.xlsx) plus the proposed Mutual Action Plan (mutual_action_plan.docx) and a short migration runbook (migration_runbook.pdf). Highlights below: 

Summary offer:
- Price-match: $0.009/token for generation for months 1–12, conditioned on a signed 24-month commitment and quarterly minimums (min quarterly tokens = 0.75 * stated run-rate).
- Step-up: price moves to $0.0105/token starting month 13 unless quarterly true-ups keep usage >= 90% of expected run-rate.
- One-time migration/onboarding credit: $100,000 (applied to first invoices or to onboarding vendor invoices, per your preference).
- Pilot credits: 60 days of credits to run a pilot (applied as invoice credit).
- Technical assistance: dedicated SE jumpstart (2 weeks) and priority VPC onboarding slot.
- SLA assurance: 30 days of service credit if we miss agreed latency/availability targets in the first 90 days post-cutover.

Technical notes (from Karthik, cc'd):
- We validated the primary model families AstraScale uses; there are no required model re-architectures for hosted->private cutover. Expected private deployment window: 4–6 weeks from signed MAP if customer provides access for testing within 5 business days.
- Egress: standard cloud egress is billable; we can either absorb the first-month outbound transfer up to $15k as part of the migration credit or add a separate egress credit line. Please indicate preference in the MAP.

Next steps we propose:
1) Confirm acceptance of the high-level terms by Friday so we can reserve the private onboarding slot.
2) Sign MAP and SOW (DocuSign link included in the Drive folder).
3) Kickoff: technical deep-dive with Karthik and team within 72 hours of signature.

Links and attachments: pricing_sheet_v1.xlsx, mutual_action_plan.docx, migration_runbook.pdf. HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/GF-2027-091

If you'd like, we can also schedule a 30-minute alignment call tomorrow to walk the commercial terms and the migration timeline.

Looking forward —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Attachments: pricing_sheet_v1.xlsx (xlsx), mutual_action_plan.docx (docx), migration_runbook.pdf (pdf)
